title.narrative: Implementation of the regional Action Plan for Arab States (2021-2027)

description.narrative: At the extended 44th session of the World Heritage Committee (Fuzhou/Online, 2021), the report of the Third Cycle of Periodic Reporting in the Arab States and the regional Action Plan (2021-2027) were adopted by the Committee. Following up on the activities undertaken during 2022 and 2023, in the context of this workplan activities that will be implemented will continue to contribute to the implementation of the regional Action Plan, particularly in terms of strengthening capacities in the protection, conservation and management of World Heritage. Focus will be on the integration of sustainable development policies in the management of World Heritage sites, disaster risk management and addressing issues relating to the impact of climate change. It will also address priority needs related to sites inscribed on the List of World Heritage in Danger.
